item.title: Zhipu Open-Sources ZCode After Repo-Upload Fix; CAICT and NSFOCUS Audits Cite Removals
item.description: Zhipu open-sourced its ZCode AI coding workbench on GitHub after removing Repo Wiki snapshot-upload paths in v3.14.0, citing CAICT and NSFOCUS audits, and said MaaS will add optional no-retention controls for standard model calls.

item.title: Alibaba Upgrades Qwen Audio Suite: LiveTranslate Latency Cut and Qwen-Audio-3.1 ASR/TTS/Realtime
item.description: At Apsara 2026, Alibaba debuted Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate with LAAL latency cut from about 2.8 to 2.3 seconds and unveiled the Qwen-Audio-3.1 family spanning ASR, TTS, Realtime and TTS-Next cinematic soundscapes.

item.title: Alibaba Cloud Unveils Agentic Cloud Stack: AgentCore, Next-Gen CPFS and HPN 8.0 Pro
item.description: At Apsara 2026, Alibaba Cloud framed an Agentic Cloud around AgentCore for full-lifecycle agent governance, a next-generation CPFS storage system with hundred-TB/s-class throughput claims, and HPN 8.0 Pro AI networking rated at 100 petabits of bandwidth.

item.title: Alibaba Puts Qwen4 Family Into Training; Roadmap Points to 5–10T Qwen4.5 and Qwen5
item.description: At Apsara Conference 2026, Alibaba said next-generation Qwen 4 is currently in training and outlined a Qwen 4.5 / Qwen 5 roadmap projected to scale toward 5 to 10 trillion parameters, while reporting recursive self-improvement gains on today's Qwen3.8-Max.

item.title: Bernstein: Kirin 9050 Pro Multicore Tops A17 Pro as Huawei Narrows Mobile-Chip Gap Without EUV
item.description: Equity research firm Bernstein says Huawei's Kirin 9050 Pro, estimated at a 7nm-class node and built with LogicFolding under the Tau Scaling Law, beat Apple's 3nm A17 Pro in Geekbench 6 multicore and cut the mobile-chip gap to about three years—without EUV lithography.
